notes: Single choice is a string with oneOf {const, title} options: at most 400, each const unique. const is any string of at most 20000 characters. title may be empty and is at most 400 characters.

variants.case: option value is any string, title may be empty

wrong_answers.behaviour: accept duplicate option values and take the first
wrong_answers.why: The buyer picked one title and the business recorded another.
